mapper.sql: al.id, al.workspace_id, al.org_id, al.action, al.entity_type, al.entity_id, al.actor_id, al.integrity_workspace_id, al.integrity_org_id, al.integrity_actor_id, al.integrity_reference_state, al.actor_label, al.target_label, al.outcome, al.summary, al.changes, al.context, al.ip_address, al.user_agent, al.session_id, al.request_id, al.chain_scope_type, al.chain_scope_id, al.chain_index, al.prev_hash, al.row_hash, al.created_at, u.display_name AS current_actor_label
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (workspace_id, org_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, actor_id, integrity_workspace_id, integrity_org_id, integrity_actor_id, actor_label, target_label, integrity_reference_state, outcome, summary, changes, context, ip_address, user_agent, session_id, request_id, chain_scope_type, chain_scope_id, chain_index, prev_hash, row_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{orgId}, #{action}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{actorId}, #{integrityWorkspaceId}, #{integrityOrgId}, #{integrityActorId}, #{actorLabel}, #{targetLabel}, #{integrityReferenceState}, #{outcome}, #{summary}, #{changes}, #{context}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{sessionId}, #{requestId}, #{chainScopeType}, #{chainScopeId}, #{chainIndex}, #{prevHash}, #{rowHash}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = al.actor_id WHERE al.org_id = #{orgId} AND al.workspace_id IS NULL AND ( (al.chain_scope_type = 'organization' AND al.chain_scope_id = #{orgId}) OR (al.chain_scope_type IS NULL AND al.integrity_workspace_id IS NULL) ) ORDER BY al.chain_index IS NULL, al.chain_index ASC, al.created_at ASC, al.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = al.actor_id WHERE al.org_id = #{orgId} AND al.workspace_id IS NULL AND ( (al.chain_scope_type = 'organization' AND al.chain_scope_id = #{orgId}) OR (al.chain_scope_type IS NULL AND al.integrity_workspace_id IS NULL) ) ORDER BY al.created_at DESC, al.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
